# ISS-0107 — The e2e kit, found outside the change of REQ-105: a process group stays registered after its leader ended (a reused number could get SIGKILL), and `browser.js` has the error shapes that `stand.js` fixed

Серьёзность: LOW. Статус: open. Найдено: SECURITY-REVIEWER (шаг 03, находка F4, issue I2), REVIEWER (шаг 04, issue I2), CODE-FIXER (шаг 04b, issue I2), прогон `E2E105-20261105-01`, 2026-11-08; заведено DOC-UPDATER (шаг 10), 2026-11-15T16:39:45Z. Пункт планки: Q10 (отказ не роняет процесс и оставляет чистое состояние), Q5 (тест держит поведение). Требования: REQ-104 (сделано; общий механизм набора `cleanup.js` и `browser.js`), REQ-105 (сделано; `stand.js`). Решение: `decisions/0109`, О16 (находки вне изменения открываются дефектами на шаге 10; две формы `browser.js` исправлены в новом `stand.js` в этом прогоне, F4 — нет). Две причины в одном файле: номер выдан один (задание шага 10); пункты 1 и 2 ниже чинятся отдельно, ORCH может разделить их по номерам (О16: одна причина — один дефект).

## Что не так

1. **A group number stays registered after its leader ended by itself (F4 of step 03).** When a stand ends by itself and its process group is already empty, its group number stays registered, with its runner record and its marker folder, until `stop()`, the exit handler or the runner's sweep. If the number were reused by a new process-group leader in that window, that group would get `SIGKILL`. The places: `tools/test/e2e/kit/stand.js` (`stop()`: the final `SIGKILL` to the group also when the leader ended long before, and `unregisterGroup` only there), and the same shape in the released shared code `tools/test/e2e/kit/cleanup.js` (the exit handler of `installHandlers`, and the runner sweep `sweepBrowserRegistry`, which kills any well-formed record whose marker exists) and `tools/test/e2e/kit/browser.js` (the groups of Chrome). Simulated, not reproduced by a real reuse: SECURITY-REVIEWER gave `stop()` the number of another group through `deps.spawn` and that group was killed (trial 5 D), and a well-formed record with an existing marker made the sweep kill the group it names (trial 5 E). Process numbers are sequential on this macOS (8 starts: 48843–48850), so a reuse needs a wrap of the number space inside the window.
2. **`browser.js` and `withBrowser` have the error shapes that `stand.js` fixed at step 04b (I2 of REVIEWER, step 04; I2 of CODE-FIXER, step 04b).** In `tools/test/e2e/kit/browser.js`: (a) the start touches `child.stderr` before the child's `error` listener exists (lines 224–252 at step 04): when the spawn fails with `EMFILE`, Node returns a child without pipes and emits `error` on the next tick, so the start throws a `TypeError` instead of the kit's error and the `error` event has no listener (measured for `stand.js` under `ulimit -n 64`; `browser.js` itself was not run so, it needs Chrome); (b) `withBrowser` attaches the error to itself as `cleanupError` when the body awaited a failing close (`error.cleanupError === error`); (c) `withBrowser` assigns `failure.cleanupError` without protection, so a frozen body error together with a failing close is replaced by a `TypeError` (reproduced by CODE-FIXER in a copy); (d) `withBrowser` uses `failure === null` as the mark of «no failure», so a body that throws `null` passes as a success (reproduced: it resolves with `undefined`). `withStand` of `stand.js` keeps a separate flag and rethrows `null`, attaches no error to itself and protects the assignment (tests `E2S-15`; the mutants T06 and T07 of step 05 are red there).

Why LOW: item 1 needs a wrap of the process numbers inside a short window on the developer's own computer; item 2 needs a failing spawn (`EMFILE`), a failing close after a failed body, a frozen error object or a thrown `null` — none happens in the specs of Sai today, and every path still ends the browser.

## Доказательство

- Item 1: `handoffs/E2E105-20261105-01/step-03-security-reviewer.json` — finding F4 (Low; `place`, `what`, `fix`), issue I2 (one defect for the three places, AP-014); `decisions/0109`, О16.
- Item 2: `handoffs/E2E105-20261105-01/step-04-reviewer.json` — findings L1 and L2 (the same shapes in `stand.js`, fixed at step 04b) and issue I2 (`browser.js`, Low); `handoffs/E2E105-20261105-01/step-04b-code-fixer.json` — issue I2 (a) and (b) with the trials; `handoffs/E2E105-20261105-01/step-05-test-designer.json` — mutants T06, T07 (red in `E2S-15`).
- To see 2 (d) in a copy outside the project: call `withBrowser` with a body that throws `null` and look at the result: the promise resolves.

## Как исправить

1. On the end of the leader, when `kill(-pid, 0)` already gives `ESRCH`, unregister the group, drop its runner record and skip the later group signals — in `stand.js`, `browser.js` and `cleanup.js` together, as one change of the shared mechanism (AP-014), with a test that hands the starter the number of a foreign group through `deps.spawn` and asserts that group is not signalled.
2. In `browser.js`: listen for the child's `error` before the pipes are touched (as `stand.js` does), and in `withBrowser` keep a separate flag for «the body failed», rethrow the body's error as it is (also `null`), attach `cleanupError` only when it is not the body's error itself and only when the assignment can be made (as `withStand`). Each with a kit test that is red before the change.

A weaker test, a skip or a removed check is not a fix (Q6).

## Маршрут

WF-03 for BACKEND-DEV (the kit is REQ-104 code) with SECURITY-REVIEWER and REVIEWER, then TEST-DESIGNER for the tests; item 2 can ride with ISS-0100 (the same file `browser.js`). On ORCH's order.
